namespace.description: Overrides the core.register({ creator, pack }) scan. Required only when the scan fails (no call, or creator/pack composed at runtime instead of written as string literals).

defaultLocale.description: The locale whose resource file defines the shape and the types; every other locale must carry exactly its key set.

sourceDir.description: Where the per-locale resource modules live, relative to the Regolith temp workspace.

vanilla.description: Generate the $.vanilla.* key tree and bundle the vanilla strings your scripts reference. Vanilla strings are never emitted into the RP either way.

vanillaLangUrlTemplate.description: URL template vanilla .lang files are fetched from — {locale} is replaced with the locale code.

cacheMaxAgeHours.description: Hours before a locale's cached vanilla .lang is considered stale.

strict.description: Fail the build on check violations (locale parity, variable drift, invalid overrides…) instead of warning.
